explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/700 and the docstring's quote of [ErSz78, p.98], where P(n) is 'the greatest prime power which divides n'. This variant asks to characterise the composite n with f(n) = n/Q(n), with Q(n) = max p^{v_p(n)}. That reading is also suggested by the page's own argument that gcd(n, C(n,p^k)) = n/p^k for p^k ∥ n. Defined and stated correctly as a value question. Faithful.
